verdict.rationale: First-party docs show natural-language operation across major surfaces. Genie answers data questions in natural language and returns SQL, results and visualizations. Genie Code chats, generates and runs code, builds pipelines and AI/BI dashboards, debugs errors, and can act as an autonomous agent that plans and runs tasks with approval gates. Dashboards can also be authored from natural language. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of how reliably these NL commands work, and evidence that platform administration (compute, permissions, workspace configuration) can be driven by natural language.
